climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA in Monterey County on the eastern flank of the Santa Lucia Mountains, with vineyards up to 1,200 feet, about half planted to Pinot Noir. Cool morning fog and Monterey Bay breezes give way to warm afternoons on sun-facing slopes.
